LESSON: WORD AND SENTENCE LISTENING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: Word and sentence LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Word and sentence LISTENING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the number of syllables 2 lessons
2. recognize words with similar sounds
3. combine syllables to form words
4. combine words to make simple sentences e) appreciate that syllables form words

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the number of syllables 2 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the number of syllables 2 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recognize words with similar sounds
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize words with similar sounds. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. combine syllables to form words
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to combine syllables to form words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. combine words to make simple sentences e) appreciate that syllables form words
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to combine words to make simple sentences e) appreciate that syllables form words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Word and sentence LISTENING.
2. Explain Word and sentence LISTENING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Word and sentence LISTENING.
4. Show that you can: identify the number of syllables 2 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Word and sentence LISTENING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Word and sentence LISTENING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the number of syllables 2 lessons
2. recognize words with similar sounds
3. combine syllables to form words
4. combine words to make simple sentences e) appreciate that syllables form words

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
